records.original_title: #455 R213: bound drip consumer ML prediction to non-espresso evidence [skip netlify]
records.original_body:
## Owner Option B — SAFE research-only increment
Original [Gunning et al. 2026](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41538-026-00779-7) Methods/Results/Discussion independently reviewed. The published 118-consumer/27-brew, 3,186-row dataset was one medium-roast **drip** coffee, not an espresso intervention, and its published 80/20 row-level holdout (0.75 accuracy, 0.81 AUROC; regression R² 0.47/MAE ~1.03 nine-point units) is not demonstrated independent new-coffee/new-user generalization. Original 9-point JAR/CATA are not DIC five 1–5 ratings. Consumer clusters are observational, not causal next-shot evidence. DOI, original links, limitations, live exact blobs and evidence are in same-commit scoped journal.

**Only two documentation paths**, 112/335/171 prior ledger records preserved with +1 source/+2 checks/+1 held proposal -> 113/337/172. Git source preflight `c2f5a9e2f49d0b8dc1e0985c17a22844e6154d2a`, preflight blob `2fb236bbfa6bac48513eeb3bd157b260853af06d`, exact journal line recorded. No application, tests, SQL/Auth, release queue, member data, production, Locked change, or deployment. Original PDF raw data/figures and S019 remain unverified. Please run applicable PR exact-source CI; will merge only if actual applicable statuses permit.
records.finding: Gunning et al. 2026 consumer model uses one medium-roast drip coffee, observational 9-point JAR/CATA; neither 0.81 AUROC nor 3,186 rows prove DIC espresso five-rating next-shot efficacy.
records.disposition: Preserve bounded research caveat and separate owner evidence; no product heuristic change or unverified real-world taste claim.
